main_idea: GRPO training raised Qwen3.8-27B's DeepSWE pass@1 from 27.8% to 39.1%.
ideas: GRPO training improved DeepSWE pass@1 by 11.3 points
Training used 500 expert-authored software engineering tasks
Training data came from diverse real-world codebases
Training used eight attempts per task with GRPO
summary: Clutter: slogan headline, eyebrow, subtitle, frames, stats row, method cards and footer bury the clean bar chart. Missing: the model name, which only appears in the removed eyebrow.

missing.why: Qwen3.8-27B appears only in the eyebrow, which is removed, so the chart does not name the model.
